'''Zika''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a galactic conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], Zika spent two days on [[Paklan]] following [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] to a diner. Zika told [[Toomey]] the location of the brothers, and received his payment before Toomey and the band of bounty hunters were killed.
